Work item B-135 (servers plan 0002 T16, command-line tool adapter) is written, reviewed and gate-checked in the worktree <worktrees>/b135 (read-only for you), pull request 345 is open, and local CI fails every time on a defect of merged test code, not of B-135: the helper `_meta_run_id` in packages/eng-harness/tests/unit/test_runner.py (about line 320) uses `with sqlite3.connect(...) as db:`, which commits but never closes the connection, so the journal.sqlite-wal and -shm files exist when the test takes its 'before' listing and vanish when the connection is garbage-collected (this is also the cause of the flaky test_caller_chosen_run_id noted earlier). The repair writer's trial patch is <lead>/reports/b135-trial-test-runner.patch (plus 4, minus 1 lines, test file only, 0 counted lines; the gate without mutation passed with it).
